definitions.explanation: A work of art, literature, film, or other creative endeavor that is considered outstanding in quality.

examples.japanese: これは{秀作|しゅうさく}だ。
{今年|ことし}の{映画祭|えいがさい}には{秀作|しゅうさく}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many fine works at this year's film festival.

examples.japanese: {数|かず}ある{応募|おうぼ}{作品|さくひん}の{中|なか}から{秀作|しゅうさく}が{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: An excellent piece was selected from among the many submitted works.

notes:
Composed of {秀|しゅう} (excellent, outstanding) + {作|さく} (work, production). Used to praise creative works such as novels, films, paintings, and other artistic products. Slightly more formal than simply saying いい{作品|さくひん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秀作|しゅうさく}ぞろい: a collection of excellent works
- {秀作|しゅうさく}を{生|う}み{出|だ}す: to produce an excellent work
- {隠|かく}れた{秀作|しゅうさく}: a hidden gem

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {傑作|けっさく}: masterpiece — implies an even higher level of achievement, a truly exceptional work, while {秀作|しゅうさく} is more moderate praise meaning 'very good'
- {名作|めいさく}: famous work, classic — emphasizes renown and lasting reputation, while {秀作|しゅうさく} focuses on quality regardless of fame
- {力作|りきさく}: ambitious work — emphasizes the effort put into creating the work rather than the quality of the result
